issue_context.title: [Bug]: Console tab in trace viewer
issue_context.body:
### Version

 1.44.1 

### Steps to reproduce

add a console log and open the trace viewer

### Expected behavior

when in console tab you should be able to click the console tab and it should highlight in the timeline just like network does

### Actual behavior

doesn't do anything, it shows that it is clickable but when you click nothing happens

### Additional context

_No response_

### Environment

```shell
System:
    OS: macOS 14.5
    CPU: (10) arm64 Apple M1 Max
    Memory: 502.19 MB / 64.00 GB
  Binaries:
    Node: 20.11.1 - /usr/local/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.19 - /usr/local/bin/yarn
    npm: 10.2.4 - /usr/local/bin/npm
    pnpm: 8.5.0 - /usr/local/bin/pnpm
  IDEs:
    VSCode: 1.90.0 - /usr/local/bin/code
  Languages:
    Bash: 3.2.57 - /bin/bash
  npmPackages:
    @playwright/test: ^1.44.1 => 1.44.1
```

review_comments: The `ListView`'s `onAccepted` handler was before only working when it was acting in 'select mode'. This means `selectedItem` was there. Now it also works without.
